name: Delta Neutral
description: This keyword returns the quantity of selected instrument required to make the net Delta of all positions in the strategy of selected underlying to zero. Returns quantity in multiples of the lot size of Instrument as float
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the quantity of selected instrument required to make the net Delta of all positions in the strategy of selected underlying to zero. Returns quantity in multiples of the lot size of Instrument as float

This keyword is usually used in QTY FX in position builder

![Example](./images/img-1631789047.png)

parameters.name: Hedge Instrument
parameters.description: Nested Futures(...) (or other) instrument used to flatten net Delta to zero.
